# Biz Graph — llms-full.txt

> Concatenated fence + schema summary + agent how-to for offline agent ingest.

---

## Fence

# Biz Graph — fence (non-negotiable)

## Source fence
- Mine ideas **only** from:
  - **The Boring Marketer** — `@boringmarketer`
  - **Chris Koerner** — `@mhp_guy`
- Every idea row requires a public `source_url` and should carry `evidence_quote` when available.
- Public sources only. No paywall scrape. No invented posts, quotes, or results.

## Claims fence
- **No income guarantees.** Past creator anecdotes ≠ your future results.
- Catalog is research / orchestration scaffolding — not financial, legal, or investment advice.

## Brandon approval gates
Agents may research and draft. These require **Brandon (human) approval** before execution:
- **money** — spend, deposit, subscribe, buy ads, pay tools beyond free tier
- **hire** — contractors, employees, agencies
- **pay** — invoices, payouts, refunds
- **publish** — public posts, product launches, site go-live as “official”
- **send** — outbound email / DM / outreach as Brandon or Biz Graph

Mark these as `human_gates` / `approval_gates` / `brandon_only_actions` in ideas, plans, and graphs.

## Repo fence
- Work only under `/workspace/biz-graph/`.
- Do not invent ideas to “fill” the ~250 target. Harvest quality, cite, then plan.

---

## Schema

# Biz Graph — catalog schema (v0)

**Fence:** Ideas only from `@boringmarketer` and `@mhp_guy` (Chris Koerner). Public cites required. No income guarantees. Brandon approval for money / hire / pay / publish / send. See `docs/FENCE.md`. Agent how-to: `llms.txt`.

## Files
| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `data/ideas.jsonl` | One idea object per line |
| `data/ideas.json` | `{ meta, ideas[] }` |
| `data/plans.jsonl` / `data/plans.json` | Plans index |
| `data/plans/{id}.json` | Full plan document |
| `data/graphs.jsonl` / `data/graphs.json` | Graphs index |
| `data/graphs/{id}.json` | Full orchestration graph |

## Idea
`id`, `title`, `one_liner`, `source_handle` (`boringmarketer`|`mhp_guy`), `source_url` (required), `source_date`, `evidence_quote`, `category[]`, `why_it_works`, `agent_runnable`, `human_gates[]`, `status` (`harvested`|`researched`|`planned`|`archived`), `collected_at`, `notes`

ID: `idea-{source}-{slug}-{nnn}`

## Plan (per idea)
`id` (`plan-{idea_id}`), `idea_id`, `title`, `one_liner`, `category_tags[]`, `why_agent_runnable`, `ops_steps[]` (`n,title,owner,detail,human_required`), `human_only_checkpoints[]`, `hiring_and_pay_flow`, `orchestration_graph_id`, `unit_economics_sketch`, `first_7_day_agent_sprint[]`, `kill_criteria[]`, `source_citations[]`, `disclaimer`, `status`, `updated_at`

## Graph
`id` (`graph-{plan_id}`), `plan_id`, `description`, `nodes[]` (`id,kind,label,model_or_tool?,responsibility`), `edges[]` (`from,to,label`), `brandon_only_actions[]`, `updated_at`

## Agent update contract
Append-only IDs. Every idea needs public `source_url` from the two handles only. Propose patches under `data/proposals/`. Never invent quotes or revenue. Brandon gates money/hire/pay/publish/send.

---

## Agent how-to (llms.txt)

# Biz Graph — agent instructions

> Ideas only from @boringmarketer and @mhp_guy. Public cites required. No income guarantees. Brandon gates money / hire / pay / publish / send.

## Read
| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `/schema.md` or `/data` via site | schemas |
| `/data/ideas.jsonl` | ideas |
| `/data/plans/{id}.json` | full plans |
| `/data/graphs/{id}.json` | orchestration graphs |
| `/docs/FENCE.md` | fence |

## IDs
- idea: `idea-{source}-{slug}-{nnn}`
- plan: `plan-{idea_id}`
- graph: `graph-{plan_id}`

## Updates
Append jsonl + regenerate json meta. Cite public X/YouTube URLs only from the two creators. Do not invent ideas.
